question: Describe a time you identified an error in financial data and how you resolved it.
intendedUser: Finance professional with 1-3 years of experience
description: Behavioural question assessing attention to detail and data integrity in financial work.
purposeOfQuestion: The interviewer evaluates the candidate's ability to spot discrepancies, follow investigation procedures, and ensure accuracy in financial reporting.
competencyAssessed: Attention to detail and financial data integrity
exampleAnswer: While reconciling monthly ledgers at my firm, I noticed a INR 50,000 discrepancy between the bank statement and our internal records. I Situation: the deadline was 2 days away. I traced the transaction to an unmatched international transfer, contacted the bank, and identified a currency conversion timing difference. I documented the finding and implemented a stricter cut-off procedure. Result: discrepancy resolved, and the new procedure prevented future mismatches.
evaluationCriteria: Error detection ability, investigation methodology, corrective action specificity, preventive follow-through
